retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic sage green layout featuring tactile embossed elements, combining a central line-art botanical illustration with a mix of serif and script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square, minimalist composition in a single shade of pale sage green, where all visual information—text, illustration, and braille—is conveyed through subtle embossing and darker green outlines, creating a highly tactile and unified surface.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic color harmony between background and graphic elements
Vertical hierarchy moving from serif title to script subtitle to central illustration
Contrast between geometric square framing and organic botanical line work
Integration of tactile braille as a functional design element at the base
coreInvariants: Embossed or debossed tactile effect on all primary elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A square-framed botanical illustration occupies the lower-center, acting as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central botanical line drawing within its thin-line square border.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow starting from the wide-spaced serif header, through the fluid script title, landing on the central illustration, and ending at the braille block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive open margins around the central cluster emphasize the minimalist, quiet aesthetic.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Medium sage green for outlines and shadows
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value; very narrow tonal range to simulate depth through shadow rather than hue.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of high-contrast serif and fluid, expressive script
letterConstructionRules: Upper-case serif for the top header with wide tracking
Fluid, connected script for the main title with varying stroke weights
All text features a 3D embossed effect with subtle drop shadows
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'L' and 'P' feature elongated, sweeping descenders and ascenders
Serif 'W' has a wide, classical structure
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Classical wide-spaced serif paired with a dynamic, handwritten-style script for organic contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, elegant serif header style
Captures the fluid, energetic movement of the main title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid pale sage green square background with a central square-framed botanical line drawing of an orchid, all rendered in a monochromatic embossed style with subtle shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the display text using a mix of wide-spaced serif for the top line and fluid script for the middle lines, ensuring all text is embossed to match the background texture.

verificationChecks: Is the entire design monochromatic sage green?
Are all elements (text and art) rendered with a tactile embossed effect?
Is the script text fluid and connected?
Is there a block of braille at the bottom?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent light source on all embossed elements
Verify the script is legible despite the monochromatic treatment
Ensure the square frame is perfectly centered
Confirm the braille dots are distinct and organized in a grid
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Sage + Blind Embossing + Botanical Line Art + Script/Serif Pairing
